kaynaklar.wikimedia: Airbus A320-211 Air Canada C-FKCK 18 November 2019.jpg

sahneler.metin: At night, an Airbus lined up to land on a crowded taxiway in San Francisco.
Suddenly the crew went around, passing just feet above waiting jets.
Four airliners were on that taxiway.
One runway was closed, and its lights were off.
The lit taxiway looked like the runway.
The crew asked the tower but didn't realize their mistake.
It was one of the closest calls in aviation history.
New alerts now warn when an aircraft lines up on a taxiway.

aciklama:
Air Canada 759 lined up to land on an occupied taxiway. The cause: visual misidentification at night with one runway's lights turned off.
